description: Land Acquisition - Koswatta, Kaduwela D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that certain described lands are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content provides detailed descriptions of the land parcels (extents, boundaries, lot numbers, and locations), which falls squarely under the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related matters, specifically land acquisitions.
